kms.contract: control_plane_jwt → KMS AUTH_MODE=control_plane_jwt (ES256 via CP JWKS, aud=kms, tenant map, tenant_principals directory); instance kms-cp (deploy/kms-cp)

flowcase.contract: control_plane_jwt → Flowcase AUTH_MODE=trusted_jwt (ES256 via CP JWKS, iss=CP origin, aud=flowcase, tenant_id claim); instance flowcase-cp (deploy/flowcase-cp)

agent-studio.contract: control_plane_jwt → Agent Studio AGENT_STUDIO_HUMAN_AUTH=control_plane_jwt (ES256 via CP JWKS, aud=agent-studio, access map keyed by CP user id); instance agent-studio-cp (deploy/agent-studio-cp)

case-workspace.contract: control_plane_jwt → UCW BFF (ES256 via CP JWKS, aud=case-workspace); user-scoped Flowcase/KMS calls via CP token exchange; instance case-workspace-cp (deploy/case-workspace-cp)
